title: A lane session cannot post a lane-lint comment without the lane-lint marker
why: Coordinator guard candidate, low, 04:48 CST Nov 15 (relayed; triage's call). On #3496 the lane typed lint comment 6893187872 by hand: no <!-- lane-lint --> marker, the tool printed only a PASS line and posted nothing. The comment reads as a PASS nobody ran, so it is VOID (coordinator). Harm: a typed lint is a PASS nobody ran. Fix: refuse a lane-lint comment without the marker when a lane session posts it. Same family as hand-posted record cases (#3468, #3464) and steps record-tool-posts-itself and lane-lint-background-refused (a lane runs merge --lane-lint and the tool posts; a lane never prints or types a PASS line); none covers a typed lint comment (grep of roadmap steps for hand-post, lane-lint marker, hand-typed, 04:50 CST). Kin sighting: #3494's lane printed a PASS line by hand and was refused by the classifier (step tests-never-read-live-origin-main). Past rulings checked: none found.
